source.queue_precondition: all candidates queued with attempt_count 0 at selection time

selection_configuration.method: 15 untouched queued venues per region; fixed 10/5 development/locked-holdout split per region; exact alternating known/missing source-website targets; greedy municipality-size, tourism-focus, chain, language-variant, venue-type, and municipality balancing; seeded SHA-256 tie breaks
selection_configuration.municipality_size_basis: canonical venue count in the pinned national Overture inventory, not resident population
selection_configuration.tourism_basis: operator-designed stress-test focus; not an official tourism statistic
selection_configuration.chain_basis: bounded pre-registered name pattern; chain labels are sampling aids, not ownership evidence
selection_configuration.partition_rule: within each region, deterministic slots 1-10 are development and 11-15 are locked holdout

evaluation_preregistration.tuning_policy: develop only against development; evaluate locked holdout exactly once after implementation freeze; any policy/code change caused by holdout results retires this holdout
evaluation_preregistration.review_unit: one canonical venue; publisher ownership is separately adjudicated per registrable domain

denominators.official_site_precision: published official-site predictions with a conclusive official/non-official adjudication
denominators.official_site_recall: reviewed venues with a conclusively identified official site
denominators.search_discovery_recall: reviewed venues with a conclusively identified official site that appears in the bounded search fixture
denominators.resource_role_precision: published resource links with a conclusive role adjudication
denominators.resource_role_recall: conclusively adjudicated venue resources present in the bounded fixture
denominators.abstention: reviewed venues for which the system publishes no official site
denominators.coverage: reviewed venues for which the system publishes an official site

acceptance.non_vacuity: a system that publishes nothing cannot pass
acceptance.insufficient_power: expand the offline unseen sample; do not use Brave
